The [[Leffingite/Legends|Leffingite]] criminal [[Magaloof/Legends|Magaloof]] robbed a '''jewelry store''' located in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]]<ref name="DB" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Afterward, Magaloof lost his loot to a [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Dannl Faytonni/Legends|Dannl Faytonni]], who claimed to be affiliated with the [[Republic Security Force/Legends|Republic Security Force]].<ref name="DB" />
